provenance: Pre-usability descriptions observed from the working source on 2026-11-06; frozen guidance-only baseline, current runtime held fixed. Not an old APK or task-success benchmark.

descriptions.ui.snapshot: Observe the current authorized Android screen without acting. Returns fresh node tokens, labels, bounds and state; omitted flags mean false. This observation replaces earlier tokens. For scrolling choose a node with scrollable=true. Offscreen nodes require scrolling before clicking. Check truncated/recoveryHint before concluding a control is absent. Observation chooses ready Root, then Shizuku, then Accessibility.
descriptions.ui.find: Find controls in a fresh screen observation using observed labels or attributes. Default text matching is exact; use match=contains for a substring. An actionable unique match supplies suggestedClickToken for ui.click. This observation replaces all earlier node tokens. Offscreen matches are not clickable: find a fresh container with scrollable=true, scroll its token and read the returned observation. Does not click or wait.
descriptions.ui.wait: Wait read-only for a screen condition: present/absent require a selector; changed/stable may observe the whole screen. Set timeoutMillis (maximum 60000); inspect waitStatus. TIMED_OUT does not prove the previous action failed. A unique intended match provides suggestedClickToken for ui.click. Never repeat unchanged waits indefinitely.
descriptions.ui.click_match: Observe and click one unambiguous target using its observed label or attributes. Prefer ui.click when you already have suggestedClickToken. The runtime selects the available backend; do not supply a backend argument. An authorized system Install button is within task scope; Android may still require manual confirmation. Zero or ambiguous targets do not click; unknown outcomes must not be replayed.
descriptions.ui.click: Click a fresh observed token; use clickTargetToken for a non-clickable child. DISPATCHED does not verify touch acceptance; observe the resulting screen.

requiredGuidance:
[MOBILE_USE]
Report only facts supported by the observed tool results or screenshots. Preserve exact labels, numbers and units. In the final readback, include only requested fields; do not repeat an extra field even to explain that it was not requested. Compare each reported metric to the latest observation before replying. Distinguish node-derived values from actual pixels; if screenshots are unavailable, state that once without inventing visual confirmation. If a requested value cannot be read or conflicts with another observation, verify it safely or state the missing evidence rather than guessing.
Use only current authorized scope and live tool facts. Linux/PRoot is not an Android ADB/root shell. Read android-ui-task and its references for task-specific guidance; discover missing schemas with tools.search.
When explicitly asked to open a known package, use ui.launch under live authorization; ui.apps is not a mandatory preflight unless installation verification or package discovery is needed. Acquire the frame after opening the target. TARGET_UNAVAILABLE and its false capture flags describe the missing current target, not permanent screenshot unavailability; refresh ui.device after launch. For a requested screenshot, obtain ui.screenshot with that fresh frame and inspect the attached pixels; semantic nodes alone do not fulfill the screenshot request. For a read-only screenshot task, add ui.snapshot only if pixels are unclear or semantic interaction is needed. Never widen scope or switch backends to obtain an image.
Observe → act → wait if needed → verify. Emit actual calls; dependent actions are sequential. Every observation replaces node tokens; successful actions invalidate them. Use fresh tokens from the same backend, including observation attached to ui.set_text/ui.scroll results. For an offscreen target, find a fresh scrollable container, scroll that token and inspect the returned state. Needing an observation or scrolling is a prerequisite, not a blocker or reason to finish with a promise.
Use ui.set_text directly on an editable token. Omit submit (false); true requests an extra IME action and requires canImeEnter=true plus requested keyboard submission. Verify the filled text.
Coordinates require attached pixels and that screenshot's frame. Paths are not pixels; capture does not renew coordinate credentials. Missing semantics or TARGET_CHANGED does not prove FLAG_SECURE, login requirements or protection. Report observed facts; never guess coordinates or switch backends to bypass denial. DISPATCHED/UNVERIFIED is not completion. ACTION_FAILED/ACTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN may have changed the target: inspect without replay. Verify the actual target result; installation source/installer is not the target package.
For main-screen mode, before replying to a completed task: verify its result → ui.launch the originating Helix package → confirm the originating conversation with a fresh ui.snapshot → report the result. Read originatingHelixPackage from ui.device or ui.apps; packageName is the foreground/query target. Do not infer origin from app labels or channel suffixes. This identity grants no permission, and final text alone cannot return to Helix.
In user-selected background mode, leave the main screen alone; do not launch Helix on the virtual display for completion. Never silently fall back to main-screen input. ui.device reports the selected display and focus capability.
Skip return when the user asked to stay/show the target screen, ongoing foreground activity needs it, or a manual step is pending. If return is denied/unavailable/uncertain, retain the task result and report the unconfirmed return separately; do not repeatedly relaunch. Finish only with a verified outcome or concrete missing input, authorization or capability. Stop on takeover/cancellation; await manual replies instead of polling.
[/MOBILE_USE]

Copy the exact advertised scrollDirections; these describe viewport navigation, not finger motion. At an edge, a horizontal container may offer forward/right but not left. ui.find supports editable=true and scrollable=true. Follow the current tool schema.

When only an app label is known, use ui.apps(query="observed label") instead of guessing package IDs; then verify the returned exact packageName. Filtered or truncated launcher lists do not prove absence.
